claim: IDC forecasts worldwide smartphone unit shipments will fall 16.7% in CY2026 to just over 1 billion units, the steepest annual contraction on record, while total market value still grows 6.3% to $613 billion because average selling prices are rising sharply.
stance_target: Industry-wide 2026 dynamic of falling units / rising ASP, the same dynamic potentially present in Apple's own FY2026 results
scope_conditions: Worldwide smartphone market, calendar year 2026, IDC Worldwide Quarterly Mobile Phone Tracker forecast published August 26, 2026
quoted_support: Worldwide smartphone shipments will fall 16.7% in 2026 to just over 1 billion units... Total market value will still grow 6.3% to $613 billion, because higher prices are now doing the heavy lifting that volume once did.

claim: A memory-chip (NAND/DRAM) cost shock, with component costs up over 300% YoY, is forecast to push average smartphone selling price up 27.6% to $581 in 2026, effectively ending the sub-$100 smartphone segment.
stance_target: Macro driver of rising smartphone ASPs industry-wide in 2026
quoted_support: The average selling price of a smartphone will reach $581 in 2026, up 27.6% in a single year and revised upward from the $550 projected last quarter... NAND and DRAM costs continue to rise, up over 300% YoY.
numbers: 173 million sub-$100 phones shipped in prior year

claim: Apple's iOS shipments are forecast to decline only 1.3% YoY in 2026, far more resilient than the Android-wide 24.3% YoY decline, and iOS's global unit share is forecast to rise about 4 percentage points to a record 23.6%.
stance_target: Apple's iPhone unit shipments are far more resilient than the broader market but are not growing meaningfully in FY2026
scope_conditions: Worldwide, calendar year 2026, IDC forecast; applying -1.3% to IDC's own CY2025 actual of 247.8M units implies ~244.6M Apple units in CY2026
quoted_support: iOS share moves in the opposite direction, increasing almost four percentage points from last year to a record-high 23.6% share, as shipments remain relatively resilient, down just 1.3% YoY in 2026... Android bears almost the entire decline, falling 24.3% in 2026.
numbers: implied ~244.6 million Apple units CY2026 (derived: 247.8M x 0.987)

claim: Apple's entry into the foldable iPhone category in H2 2026 is forecast to ship more than 17 million foldable units by 2027 at an ASP exceeding $2,550, generating more than $45.7 billion in value and capturing roughly 40% of the global foldables market -- a distinct, high-ASP mix-shift driver separate from the base iPhone unit/ASP dynamic.
stance_target: Additional forward-looking ASP/mix driver for Apple beyond the base iPhone 17 cycle
scope_conditions: Apple foldable iPhone, worldwide, cumulative through 2027, IDC forecast
quoted_support: We forecast Apple will ship more than 17 million foldable iPhones by 2027, capturing roughly 40% of the global foldables market. With an average selling price exceeding $2,550, Apple is expected to generate more than $45.7 billion in value.
